newsitem.title: USA: Some see Columbia/HCA shrs as a good buy-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Some see Columbia/HCA shrs as a good buy-WSJ.

text.p: Shares of Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp have fallen 12 percent since the start of a massive federal probe into its billing practices and some investors are buying at the new low prices, The Wall Street Journal said.
Omega Advisors, the money-management concern, has snapped up more than two million Columbia shares in the past two weeks, according to Wednesday's Heard on the Street column in The Journal.
But not everyone sees Columbia as a deal, the column said.

"A lot of other savvy value investors who specialize in out-of-favor stocks don't agree. They worry that Columbia's troubles with the government may take years to resolve, taking a toll greater than simply a hefty fine or settlement," the paper said.
